 Uncredited - Kyodo News 
 Naomi Osaka has been knocked out of the Pan Pacific Open by 18-year-old Mia Pohankova of Slovakia. Pohankova defeated Osaka 6-3, 7-5 on Thursday to advance to the quarterfinals after a second-round match that lasted 1 hour, 35 minutes. Osaka was seeded No. 7 and playing before home fans in Japan. Pohankova, who entered as a wild card, will face Alycia Parks in the quarterfinals. Pohankova was the 2025 junior singles champion at Wimbledon.

 TOKYO (AP) — Naomi Osaka , seeded No. 7 and playing before home fans in Japan, was knocked out of the Pan Pacific Open on Thursday by Mia Pohankova of Slovakia.
 Pohankova, who turned 18 a week ago and was a wildcard entry in Japan, upset Osaka 6-3, 7-5 to advance to the quarterfinals after a match that lasted 1 hour, 35 minutes.
